newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel jumps with crude, diffs hold.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel jumps with crude, diffs hold.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices jumped over 1.50 cents a gallon Wednesday tracking heating oil futures, traders said, with differentials steady but activity scant as players stuck to the sidelines amid concern over the continuing drama in Iraq.
New York Harbor aviation-quality 54-grade jet was talked between 4.25 cents and 4.50 cents over October futures, stable with Tuesday, traders said.
Gulf Coast 54-grade was offered at 1.20 cents over the print, players said, steady with Tuesday numbers for back-26th-cycle material.
